stem: A conveyor jam stops work. The operator SOP does not authorize guard removal, and the usual maintenance lead cannot be reached. The jam is visible and appears easy to clear by hand. What is the strongest response?
choices: Remove the guard because the normal decision-maker is unavailable
Hold the equipment in the controlled status, use the alternate escalation path, and do not expand operator authority into servicing
Reach through the guard opening while another worker holds the stop control
Clear the jam only if production delay exceeds one hour
rationale: The absence of the usual supervisor or maintenance lead does not transfer servicing authority. The technician preserves the controlled equipment status and follows the alternate escalation path instead of crossing a guard or hazardous-energy boundary.
